title: SetNodesReviewedRequest
description: Parameters of analysis.setReviewed. Marks or unmarks nodes of the repository's most recent analysis. Takes a list rather than one id so that marking a whole container is one round trip rather than thirty.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path to the worktree root.

nodeIds.description: Ids of the nodes to mark. Every id must belong to the stored analysis; one that does not is rejected and nothing is written.

reviewed.description: True marks the nodes reviewed, false unmarks them. The same call does both so the interface has one toggle rather than two methods.
